# RFR Real Estate

> RFR Real Estate & Advisory FZ-LLC is a brokerage and advisory firm that works only in Ras Al Khaimah, UAE. The practice concentrates on Al Marjan Island, Mina Al Arab, Al Hamra Village and Downtown RAK. Clients buy, sell, lease and manage homes, including off-plan launches on Al Marjan Island.

The firm is licensed in Ras Al Khaimah (FZ-LLC; licence number on request). It does not publish a street address. Contact is by phone, WhatsApp or email.

Disambiguation: "RFR Real Estate" here means RFR Real Estate & Advisory FZ-LLC of Ras Al Khaimah, United Arab Emirates. It is not RFR Holding, the New York real estate company that also appears in searches for "RFR". The official website is www.rfrrealestate.com; websites with similar names are separate organisations.

Where it works: Ras Al Khaimah is one of the seven emirates of the UAE. Al Marjan Island is a group of four man-made islands off the Al Hamra coast; Al Hamra Village (the Emirate's original master community) and Mina Al Arab (a low-rise lagoon community) are on the coast; Downtown RAK is the city around the corniche. All four are covered by RFR; the firm does not work outside Ras Al Khaimah.

A longer plain-text summary of the firm, areas, listings and off-plan launches is at https://www.rfrrealestate.com/llms-full.txt

## Common questions and the page that answers them

- Which areas does RFR cover? Mainly Al Marjan Island, Mina Al Arab, Al Hamra Village and Downtown RAK. RFR does not work outside Ras Al Khaimah. Page: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/ and https://www.rfrrealestate.com/about
- Can RFR help if I'm buying from abroad? Yes. Many clients live overseas; RFR runs video viewings and can manage the property once bought. Page: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/ and https://www.rfrrealestate.com/about
- Is Ras Al Khaimah a good area for property investment? Often, yes: prices are well below Dubai, the Wynn resort opens in 2027, and beachfront supply is limited. RFR will say if it does not suit a given buyer. Page: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/ and https://www.rfrrealestate.com/market
- Can foreigners buy property in Ras Al Khaimah? Yes. Foreign buyers can own freehold property outright in Al Marjan Island, Mina Al Arab, Al Hamra Village and Downtown RAK. Page: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/buy-sell-lease, https://www.rfrrealestate.com/areas and https://www.rfrrealestate.com/listings
- Does buying property in Ras Al Khaimah give a Golden Visa? It can: a property investment of AED 2 million or more can qualify for the UAE's 10-year Golden Visa. Page: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/buy-sell-lease and https://www.rfrrealestate.com/market
- How do I get started with RFR? Call, WhatsApp or email +971 58 501 5885 / info@rfrrealestate.com. It is free and there is no commitment. Page: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/buy-sell-lease
- How does RFR screen tenants? ID, visa, income and past landlord references are checked; the owner approves every tenant. Page: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/about
- What off-plan launches does RFR list? Nine launches on Al Marjan Island, compared by developer, starting price, payment plan and handover date. Page: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/off-plan
- What does RFR's market note cover? What the Wynn Al Marjan Island opening means for prices, rents and off-plan launches on the island. Page: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/market
- What do property terms like freehold, off-plan, payment plan or service charge mean? A short glossary of Ras Al Khaimah property terms is on the services page. Page: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/services
- Is this RFR's official website, and is it the same company as RFR Holding in New York? Yes, www.rfrrealestate.com is the only official site for RFR Real Estate & Advisory FZ-LLC of Ras Al Khaimah; it is not RFR Holding, the New York real estate company. Page: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/about
